title: ReaDy: Recurrent States as Dynamic Context for Speculative Drafting in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20503v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead

translated_title: ReaDy：循环状态作为混合线性注意力大语言模型中推测性草拟的动态上下文
translated_abstract: 推测解码通过每步草拟多个token来加速自回归生成，然而基于特征的起草器依赖于目标模型的隐藏特征，其上下文侧重点可能与后续草拟位置的需求不一致。混合线性注意力（HLA）模型维护着能够积累历史关联的紧凑循环状态，为推测性草拟提供了一种高效的补充上下文来源。我们提出了ReaDy，据我们所知，这是首个在草拟过程中利用HLA循环状态进行位置特定上下文检索的推测解码方法。ReaDy为每个草拟位置配备一个可学习的查询，直接从目标模型已提交的循环状态中检索补充上下文。轻量级的状态读取器通过残差更新将这些上下文整合到草稿表示中，同时低秩状态读取和融合算子使额外的计算与I/O开销保持在较低水平。
tldr: ReaDy是首个利用混合线性注意力模型循环状态作为动态上下文的推测解码方法，通过为每个草拟位置设置可学习查询直接从目标模型循环状态中检索补充上下文，以极低的计算开销提升草拟质量。
en_tdlr: ReaDy is the first speculative decoding method that leverages hybrid linear attention recurrent states as dynamic context, using learned queries at each draft position to retrieve supplementary context from the target's committed recurrent states with minimal computational overhead.
